entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQL Server: use the new modify method for partial update on the json type #36434
    11.0.0
  • The original values are not set for complex values mapped to JSON when queried #36433
    10.0.0

Closed

  • GUI context entities not updating with transaction context data updates, except new entities #36305
  • 9.0.6 throws PendingModelChangesWarning with IdentityDbContext<T> #36314
  • Debug assertion failure in InternalEntryBase.GetCurrentValue for complex JSON property #36428
    10.0.0
  • ChangeTracker.DebugView.LongView throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException with tracked complex property #36427
    10.0.0
  • Scaffold-DbContext with DataAnnotations depends on Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore package #36435
  • SQL Server: Allow switching to the new JSON type by default #34416

PullRequests

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36425
  • Finish the implementation of the SaveChanges support for JSON-mapped complex collections #36432

Updated
